marketplace.description: Agent teams you call by domain. Every team ships in one plugin, each with its own subagents and one entry skill that runs them. Three teams ship today: a software team (architect, engineer, test engineer), a content team (scout, writer, designer, brand, QA), and a product team (discovery, spec, UX, reviewer).
